# renmods

An R package to download, import, and filter data from [B.C.’s
Environmental Monitoring Data
System](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/environment/research-monitoring-reporting/monitoring/environmental-monitoring-data-system)
(EnMoDs) into R. The ‘renmods’ package replaces ‘rems’ to support the
new data system released in March 2026.

The EnMoDs dataset is licensed under the [Open Government Licence -
British
Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content?id=A519A56BC2BF44E4A008B33FCF527F61).

### Features

- Download EnMoDS data and cache locally
- Converts to Parquet files for speedy connections and filtering
- Straightforward data connections, only to as much data as required to
  speed up load times.

### Installation

If installing on Linux, see the troubleshooting section below for a
faster method.

``` r

# install.packages("pak") # if not already installed

library(pak)
pkg_install("bcgov/renmods")
```

### Updating

After updating, it’s recommended to remove your cache and re-download
the data. The downloads will take a bit of time, but this will ensure
there are no complications due to the update.

Note that will get a warning if you try to work with data downloaded
with a different version of renmods.

``` r

library(renmods)
cache_remove()
renmods_update("all")
```

Started](https://bcgov.github.io/renmods/articles/renmods.html) tutorial
for details

### Getting Help or Reporting an Issue

To report bugs/issues/feature requests, please file an
[issue](https://github.com/bcgov/renmods/issues/).

### Troubleshooting

**Installing duckdb on Linux is so slow!!!**

Solution: First install duckdb from the Posit Public Package Manager for
Linux, then continue on with your installation of renmods.

(ref: <https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb-r#installation-from-cran>)

``` r

install.packages(
  "duckdb",
  repos = sprintf(
    "https://p3m.dev/cran/latest/bin/linux/manylinux_2_28-%s/%s",
    R.version["arch"],
    substr(getRversion(), 1, 3)
  )
)
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`cache_dir()`](https://bcgov.github.io/renmods/reference/cache_dir.md)
  : Get or create cache directory
- [`cache_remove()`](https://bcgov.github.io/renmods/reference/cache_remove.md)
  : Remove cached data
- [`cache_status()`](https://bcgov.github.io/renmods/reference/cache_status.md)
  : View cache status
- [`collect`](https://bcgov.github.io/renmods/reference/collect.md) :
  Force computation of a database query
- [`db_add_date()`](https://bcgov.github.io/renmods/reference/db_add_date.md)
  : Create new field with local date
- [`db_fmt_times()`](https://bcgov.github.io/renmods/reference/db_fmt_times.md)
  : Convert to date/time
- [`renmods_connect()`](https://bcgov.github.io/renmods/reference/renmods_connect.md)
  : Connect to EnMoDS data via DuckDB
- [`renmods_disconnect()`](https://bcgov.github.io/renmods/reference/renmods_disconnect.md)
  : Disconnect from the database
- [`renmods_update()`](https://bcgov.github.io/renmods/reference/renmods_update.md)
  : Update cached EnMoDS data
